value.rationale: The exact classification measures a naturally motivated loss of ordinary unary necessity semantics in filter-valued modal logic under removal of the Boolean least value. It exposes an exponential rarity of principal-valued maps despite only a one-element algebraic deletion and a complete impossibility boundary in the monadic S5-like subclass. This is a structural and asymptotic classification rather than routine table extrapolation.
